subject: general
question: Which scheme was launched in the rural areas of the country to bring every assisted family above the poverty line within three years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana** was launched in **1999 **to provide** self-employment opportunities** to** rural poor** and bring assisted families **above the poverty line** within **three years.**
 
• This Yojana is a program that is implemented by **commercial banks, cooperative banks, and regional banks **and is overseen by the **federal government **and **state governments **in a** 75:25** ratio.
 
• As the name implies, the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana primarily targets **low-income households** or groups - referred to as **"Swarrozgars"** in the local vernacular.
 
• It aims to generate** revenue and jobs** in order to assist people in rising **beyond the poverty line.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gramin Udyami Yojana is** also known as** Rural Entrepreneurship Development Programme.**

 
 
• It was launched in **1995** to provide **self-employment** opportunities to** rural artisans** and** unemployed youth.**
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana** was launched in **1993.**
 
 
• It aimed to provide employment opportunities to the **urban and rural unemployed youth.**
 
 
 
• **Garib Kalyan Rozgar Yojana** was launched in **2020.**
 
 
• It aimed to provide employment opportunities to** migrant workers** who returned to their home states during the COVID-19 pandemic.
